Label: Rare
Definition: Not expected during the life of the operation; would need several independent control failures.

Label: Unlikely
Definition: Has happened in the industry but is not expected at this operation within several years.

Label: Possible
Definition: Could occur within a few years; relies partly on consistent human performance or unverified controls.

Label: Likely
Definition: Expected to occur within a year; known weaknesses exist in the controls.

Label: Almost certain
Definition: Expected to occur repeatedly; the conditions for the event exist routinely.
